title: Adecco Group rolls out Agentforce Coworker to 27,000 staff in 40-plus countries
slides: Adecco just deployed an AI coworker to 27,000 people. Why?
Agentforce Coworker handles repetitive tasks across 40 countries
But it doesn't replace recruiters — it augments their daily work

thread_text:
1. 27,000 People Got an AI Coworker

Adecco just deployed Agentforce Coworker to 27,000 employees. It handles repetitive tasks, but doesn't replace recruiters — it augments their daily work.

2. 40 Countries, One AI

Agentforce Coworker operates across 40 countries at Adecco. It automates repetitive tasks, freeing recruiters to focus on human connections.

3. Not Replacement, Augmentation

Adecco's AI coworker doesn't replace recruiters. It takes over repetitive work so they can spend more time on strategic hiring.

4. Your Job Next?

If your role involves repetitive tasks, an AI teammate is likely coming. The question is how you'll adapt and what new skills you'll need.

5. Ask Your Boss Today

Ask your boss: which tasks can AI take off my plate? Start the conversation now to stay ahead.
